candidate_breakdown.q1_text: Hello, my name is Amir, and I am applying to inVision U because I believe it could be a valuable opportunity for my personal and professional development.
candidate_breakdown.q2_text: As for the program itself, I am especially interested in entrepreneurship or technology-related tracks, because those fields are clearly important in today’s world. Business and technology influence almost everything now, and I feel that becoming more familiar with them would be useful for building a successful future. At this stage, I would not say that I have a fully defined plan, but I do want to improve myself and move toward better opportunities.
candidate_breakdown.q3_text: One challenge I have faced was my first year at university. It was a difficult period because many things were unfamiliar to me, and I often felt confused, especially because my English was not strong enough to fully understand everything around me. What helped me most was simply time, patience, and some support from friends. Gradually, things became easier, and I continued.
candidate_breakdown.q4_text: My long-term goal is to become a successful person, possibly by building a good career in an international company or maybe even creating my own business one day. I think this program could help me by giving me useful skills and the chance to meet ambitious, intelligent people. What motivates me most is the desire to build a better future for myself and make my family proud.
candidate_breakdown.q5_text: For me, leadership means being able to take responsibility and guide others when needed. One example I can mention is a class project where nobody wanted to do the presentation, so I volunteered to present it. It was not a very big situation, but I was willing to step forward when necessary, and I think that also says something about leadership.
candidate_breakdown.q6_text: My family supports my decision. They usually tell me that if I believe something is good for my future, I should try it. My biggest source of encouragement is my mother, because she always reminds me to stay disciplined and continue studying seriously.
